prompt.task_description: You are given WMT's 10-Q filing for the quarter ending 2024-10-31. Extract and normalize the following financial metrics from the filing and XBRL data: revenue, operating_income, net_income, eps_diluted, total_assets, total_liabilities, stockholders_equity, operating_cash_flow, and operating_margin. Report all monetary values in USD (unscaled). Use only information available as of the filing date (2024-12-06).
prompt.output_instructions: Respond with a JSON object containing a 'metrics' key mapping each metric name to its numeric value.
